_comment: Language data of the space weather briefing: date formats, the speech style instruction, and the mock narration (what a well-behaved model returns) in all eight languages.

speech_style.en: Read this in English in a calm, clear news-presenter voice.
speech_style.ja: 落ち着いた明瞭なニュース解説の口調で、日本語で読み上げてください。
speech_style.fr: Lisez ce texte en français, d’une voix calme et claire de présentateur de journal.
speech_style.es: Lee este texto en español con una voz tranquila y clara de presentador de noticias.
speech_style.it: Leggi questo testo in italiano con la voce calma e chiara di un conduttore di notiziario.
speech_style.pt: Leia este texto em português com a voz calma e clara de um apresentador de telejornal.

en.overview: This is the space weather daily briefing for {{date}}. NOAA currently reports radio blackouts at R{{r_now}}, solar radiation storms at S{{s_now}} and geomagnetic storms at G{{g_now}}.
en.solar: Over the past {{hours_24}} hours the highest radio blackout level was R{{r_max24}} and the highest solar radiation storm level was S{{s_max24}}. The highest absorption frequency on the D-RAP map is {{drap_haf}}.
en.geomagnetic: In the {{hours_24}} hours to {{window_end}}, the highest planetary Kp index was {{kp_max24}}, during {{kp_max24_period}}. The G1 level begins at Kp {{g1_kp}}. The latest Kp is {{kp_latest}}.
en.impacts: Daytime HF signals may be weakened by absorption, and GNSS accuracy and satellite conditions may vary. These are risk indicators, not confirmed outages.
en.outlook: For {{d1_date}}, NOAA forecasts a maximum Kp of {{d1_kp}}, a {{d1_r12}} chance of R1 to R2 radio blackouts and a {{d1_s1}} chance of an S1 or greater storm. The forecast maximum Kp is {{d2_kp}} on {{d2_date}} and {{d3_kp}} on {{d3_date}}.
en.summary: This briefing covers the next {{hours_72}} hours using data from the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. It was produced automatically and is not an official forecast.

ja.geomagnetic: {{window_end}}までの{{hours_24}}時間で、惑星Kp指数の最大は{{kp_max24_period}}の{{kp_max24}}でした。G1はKp{{g1_kp}}から始まります。最新のKpは{{kp_latest}}です。

de.solar: In den letzten {{hours_24}} Stunden lag der höchste Funkausfall bei R{{r_max24}} und der höchste Strahlungssturm bei S{{s_max24}}. Die höchste Absorptionsfrequenz der D-RAP-Karte beträgt {{drap_haf}}.
de.geomagnetic: In den {{hours_24}} Stunden bis {{window_end}} betrug der höchste planetare Kp-Index {{kp_max24}}, im Zeitraum {{kp_max24_period}}. Die Stufe G1 beginnt bei Kp {{g1_kp}}. Der aktuelle Kp-Wert ist {{kp_latest}}.
de.impacts: HF-Signale können tagsüber durch Absorption geschwächt werden, und GNSS-Genauigkeit und Satellitenbedingungen können schwanken. Dies sind Risikohinweise, keine bestätigten Ausfälle.
de.outlook: Für den {{d1_date}} erwartet NOAA einen maximalen Kp von {{d1_kp}}, eine Wahrscheinlichkeit von {{d1_r12}} für Funkausfälle R1 bis R2 und von {{d1_s1}} für einen Sturm ab S1. Der vorhergesagte maximale Kp ist {{d2_kp}} am {{d2_date}} und {{d3_kp}} am {{d3_date}}.
de.summary: Dieses Briefing umfasst die nächsten {{hours_72}} Stunden auf Grundlage von Daten des NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Es wurde automatisch erstellt und ist keine offizielle Vorhersage.

fr.impacts: Les signaux HF de jour peuvent être affaiblis par l’absorption, et la précision GNSS ainsi que l’environnement des satellites peuvent varier. Ce sont des indicateurs de risque, pas des pannes confirmées.
fr.outlook: Pour le {{d1_date}}, la NOAA prévoit un Kp maximal de {{d1_kp}}, une probabilité de {{d1_r12}} de perturbations radio R1 à R2 et de {{d1_s1}} d’une tempête S1 ou plus. Le Kp maximal prévu est de {{d2_kp}} le {{d2_date}} et de {{d3_kp}} le {{d3_date}}.
fr.summary: Ce bulletin couvre les {{hours_72}} prochaines heures à partir des données du NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Il a été produit automatiquement et n’est pas une prévision officielle.

ko.overview: {{date}} 우주기상 일일 브리핑입니다. NOAA의 현재 발표는 전파 장애 R{{r_now}}, 태양 방사선 폭풍 S{{s_now}}, 지자기 폭풍 G{{g_now}}입니다.
ko.solar: 지난 {{hours_24}}시간 동안 전파 장애의 최대는 R{{r_max24}}, 태양 방사선 폭풍의 최대는 S{{s_max24}}였습니다. D-RAP 지도에서 흡수가 가장 높은 주파수는 {{drap_haf}}입니다.
ko.geomagnetic: {{window_end}}까지 {{hours_24}}시간 동안 행성 Kp 지수의 최대는 {{kp_max24_period}}의 {{kp_max24}}였습니다. G1 등급은 Kp {{g1_kp}}에서 시작합니다. 최신 Kp는 {{kp_latest}}입니다.
ko.impacts: 낮 시간의 HF 신호는 흡수로 약해질 수 있으며, GNSS 정확도와 위성 환경도 변동할 수 있습니다. 이는 위험 지표이며 장애가 확인된 것은 아닙니다.
